summary: Planned mixed-use block on the Potrero Power Station masterplan with a stepped height envelope up to 180 ft, one of three blocks (with 5 and 13) eligible to host the project's single permitted district parking garage; no design review approval or construction start found.

facts.value: Residential, Institutional, Retail, Non-Retail Sales/Services (office) and Entertainment/Arts/Recreation uses permitted; Laboratory and Life Science uses Not Permitted (D4D final Table 3.1.1)

stepped envelope of 115 ft (max), 85 ft (base) and 180 ft (upper tower) across different portions of the block, per the D4D's Figure 6.2.3; the D4D's height-category text separately places Block 1 in a 'Midrise towers' category of 146-180 ft
Up to one District Parking Garage (max 90 ft, with a publicly accessible rooftop sports field) is permitted for the whole project, and may be sited only on Block 1, 5, or 13 -- not one per block
Not listed among the six Phase 1 blocks (2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15) named in the 2024 annual compliance report

open_questions: No design review approval or construction-start date found for Block 1; it is not one of the six buildings named in the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list (Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15), and no later-phase design review approval was found either.

No source found claiming a specific planned use (e.g., grocery store) beyond the D4D's own generic 'Potential District Parking Garage Location, Potential Grocery Store Location' asterisk notation, which applies to Blocks 1, 5 and 13 collectively, not to Block 1 alone.
